product.title: Hana Rainforest Helicopter Flight with Landing from Maui

description.text: Drink in the lush beauty of Maui’s Hana Rainforest and northern shores from the air on a scenic helicopter flight, including a stop at the Wailua Valley. Glide over the jungle-clad north coast, passing beauty spots like the ‘Jaws’ surf break beach and Jurassic Rock. Stops include Hana Rainforest, Hana Highway - Road to Hana. Then, land in an untouched spot in the verdant Wailua Valley, stepping out to explore the tropical vegetation and admire views over waterfalls and canyons before your return flight. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
